run_unifiedqa_train: run the unifiedqa preprocessing script to download data and process train TSV files into JSONL format
run_unifiedqa_test: run the unifiedqa preprocessing script to process test TSV files into JSONL format with multiple random seeds
run_unifiedqa_both: run the unifiedqa preprocessing script with both train and test flags to preprocess all QA data
review_process_train: review the process_train function that filters QA data by answer presence and truncates long contexts
review_process_test: review the process_test function that extracts multiple choice options and yes/no answers from TSV data
